data.camera: cowboy shot, walking forward with twin swords
data.description: 【陈 · 荒野古道】辞去警服后的泰拉荒原，残阳如血。身着行者风衣的陈背负双剑孑然独行，风沙掠过墨绿色双马尾与龙尾，身影在古道尽头挺拔如松——「龙门的陈警司已经留在昨天了。前路还长，走吧。」
data.promptProse: Chen walks alone into the wind along an ancient Terran wasteland road, twin swords strapped across her back and her sage-green travel coat pulling behind her. The cowboy shot preserves her dragon tail and windblown dark-green twin tails. Rutted earth extends past her toward the frontier. Blood-red sunset rims the coat and sword fittings, while drifting dust softens distant ridges without hiding her stride.
data.title: 陈 · 荒野古道独行
